description: South Korea national tax penalties (가산세, 국세기본법): failure to file 20% (fraud 40%) or 0.07% of revenue for bookkeeping businesses, under-reporting 10% (fraud 40%), late payment 0.022% per day, withholding late payment 3% + 0.022%/day capped at 10%, and the reduction for late filing (50/30/20% within 1/3/6 months) or amended return (90%…10% within 1 month…2 years). Shows when the next reduction step ends. No reduction after a tax audit notice.

due.description: Statutory filing and payment due date

filed.description: Date of late or amended filing

kind.description: none = did not file, under = under-reported, withholding = withholding tax paid late

noticed.description: Filed after a tax audit notice (no reduction)

paid.description: Date actually paid (default: filed date, or today)

revenue.description: Revenue, for the 0.07% comparison when a bookkeeping business did not file

today.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for days left (default: today)

name: calculate_kr_tax_penalty
title: calculate kr tax penalty
